sampling.observation_assembly: assemble 11-dim V1 vector each cycle; normalise with TRAINING-set statistics only (never live stats)

sensor_list.source: estimator (enthalpy from T_pcm) — NOT directly measurable
sensor_list.notes: state estimator, not a sensor; see fail-safe if estimator diverges

actuator_interface.notes: BYPASS and the water-side shield both drive this valve to isolate

fail_safe.principle: The shield is a hardware-level interlock independent of the learned policy. It evaluates every control cycle and overrides the policy command when a guard band is crossed.
rules: IF T_water >= bypass_water_C: force BYPASS (isolate collector, pump OFF).
IF T_pcm >= bypass_pcm_C AND T_water > T_pcm: block charge heat path.
IF any sensor stale > stale_timeout_s: fail to BYPASS (safe default).
IF f_melt estimator diverges from T_pcm-implied enthalpy: fall back to reactive rule B1 and raise an alarm.
IF hard limit exceeded despite shield: latch fault, pump OFF, alarm, require manual reset.

policy_export.onnx_export: supported — run torch.onnx.export on the policy network for MCU/edge inference (not auto-run here)
